# Cases compared against llvm-mc alone; see x86-64-llvm.txt for why each
# kind is here.
=== weak
        .text
        .globl  _first
_first: ret
        .weak   _w
_w:     ret
        call    _w
        .weak   _wu
        call    _wu
=== comdat
        .section .text$f,"xr",discard,_f
        .globl  _f
_f:     ret
        .text
        call    _f
=== def and file
        .file   "x.c"
        .def    _func; .scl 2; .type 32; .endef
        .text
        .globl  _func
_func:  ret
        call    _func
# Private labels: llvm-mc's i386 Windows objects keep any local label that
# starts with a capital L out of the symbol table, `Label` included, and keep
# `.Lfoo`, which x86-64 and ARM64 leave out.
=== private labels
        .text
Lx:     ret
.Ly:    ret
Label:  ret
        .long   Lx, .Ly, Label
        call    Label
